name: sailantis/azera-cache
description: Cache companion for the Azera framework: production-grade PSR-16 backends (Redis, File, APCu, Memcached, Memory) and decorators (Chain, Taggable, Namespace, Memoizing).

suggest.ext-memcached: For MemcachedCache backend (requires a running memcached server).
suggest.ext-memcache: For MemcacheCache backend, the legacy ext-memcache adapter (requires a running memcached server).
suggest.ext-redis: For RedisCache backend (requires a running Redis server).
